items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 November 2026 10:58pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 04 November 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the North Sea, extending a ridge across the Irish Sea area.


##Wind##

East or northeast, mainly 5 or 6, becoming mainly 4 or 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Mostly good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

East or northeast 4 or 5, decreasing mainly 4 overnight into Friday, 3 or 4 Friday morning, then 2 or 3, occasionally 4 in places, through Friday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming smooth later.


##Weather##

Isolated showers, then perhaps longer intervals of rain late on Friday.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.
